title: Multi-Generational Family Portrait, 1958 Vintage Black & White Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Janie Riggins Paul Riggins Gladys Riggins Montgomery Barry Russell Montgomery 3-2 C Late '58 or early '59
description: A black and white multi-generational family snapshot taken in late 1958 or early 1959. The photo depicts four family members: Janie Riggins, Paul Riggins in a suit with a bow tie, and Gladys Riggins Montgomery holding baby Barry Russell Montgomery against a wood-paneled interior wall.
